name: NDW BLE meter fleet · ESP32-C3
description: Up to 200 simulated water, electricity and gas meters, each a LoRaWAN Class A device joining by OTAA, whose frames go over Bluetooth to an NDW BLE Gateway nearby — the NDW LoRaWAN meter fleet with BLE for its radio. Any ESP32-C3 with 4MB of flash. The fleet's keys are programmed over USB after flashing, from flash.meterfax.com.
$comment2: An Arduino build, not ESP-IDF: boot-app0.bin is the Arduino core's otadata image, the same 8KB of 0xff the IDF builds call ota-data-initial.bin, and needed for the same reason — the console writes with eraseAll false.
